parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Dimension: brand | sku | supplier | sales_channel | product_type | sub_sales_channel | attribute | customer_tags. Required unless scope=unallocated. customer_tags fans out — an order counts toward each of its customer's tags — and the grand total is deduplicated. customer_tags does not require attribute_id.

parameters.name: dimension_value
parameters.description: The dimension row value to drill into (use 'Non-Product / Unallocated' for the unattributed row). Required unless scope=unallocated.
